items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, I don't... I saw... Barney is on it, I think; Barney Bigard.

ctx.x: Yes, I know that. He and Bobby Hackett are on the same bill. I don't know for sure if I'm going to be on it. I expected to be on it. But if that's the way they want it, that's their thing, you know? [SHORT LAUGH] Ain't nothin' to me.
Yeah, I don't... I saw... Barney is on it, I think; Barney Bigard.
-- Vic Dickenson, yes, another one. And he brought back -- who's the girl singer who used to be with Benny Goodman? The blonde girl?
